cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you
cover.title: terrifyingly good at reading your users

inner.title: watch the rage clicks
inner.body: rage clicks are rapid repeat clicks on one spot, and they hit 5.3% of retail sessions in 2025. each one is a user screaming without words.
inner.label: silent screaming

inner.title: find the drop
inner.body: the average documented cart abandonment rate is 70.22%, per baymard's 50 studies. most of your funnel is people leaving, not people buying.
inner.label: 7 in 10 gone

inner.title: measure scroll depth
inner.body: nielsen norman group found 57% of viewing time lands above the fold. if your pricing sits at the bottom, it's fighting for leftovers.
inner.label: move it up

inner.title: read your exit pages
inner.body: nielsen norman group says users often leave pages within 10 to 20 seconds. your top exit page is where your pitch lost the argument.
inner.label: 10 seconds

inner.title: cut form fields
inner.body: baymard measured 11.3 fields in the average checkout, yet most sites need only 8. every extra field is another reason to quit.
inner.label: delete three

closer.HEADLINE:
users don't complain.
they just leave.
